body:
**bug · high** NotifyAsync is `async void`, so the caller cannot await it and any exception it throws (for example ObjectDisposedException once the request-scoped DbContext is disposed) is raised on the thread pool and crashes the process.

```suggestion
    public async Task NotifyAsync(Order order)
```

<!-- bylaw:fp=a63cf312c0387e11 -->

**bug · high** The call is fire-and-forget: the action returns while ReloadAsync is still running on the scoped DbContext, which races with the end of the request (disposal or concurrent use of the same context).

```suggestion
        await orders.NotifyAsync(order);
```

<!-- bylaw:fp=6d389a58ec0c8c2d -->
